name: xflickr_crawl_health_stale

query_condition.sql:
SELECT count(CASE WHEN event='crawl.health'
  AND _timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL '90 seconds' THEN 1 END) AS health_recent
FROM "{{OPENOBSERVE_STREAM}}"
HAVING health_recent=0

description: Impact: Scheduler crawl-health telemetry is stale. Action: Check the scheduler, snapshot and OpenObserve ingestion.
